card.name: Linking words before bruising and bleeding
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (commas, 'or', 'easy', 'prolonged', 'include') just before 'bruising' or 'bleeding' in lists of low-platelet or blood-count warning signs.

modes.label: Commas and 'or' in sign lists
modes.description: A comma or 'or' right after one symptom, where bruising or bleeding is likely to come next.
modes.example: (e.g., persistent fever, bruising<<,>> bleeding, pallor) while on En

modes.description: Words like 'easy' or 'prolonged' that lead into bruising or bleeding.
